{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_float'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop the 6 QA orders with revenue 999999.99
sales_clean = sales[sales['revenue_float'] != 999999.99]

# Drop refunded orders for revenue analysis
completed_orders = sales_clean[sales_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = completed_orders[completed_orders['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute mean revenue for loyal, completed orders
mean_revenue_loyal = loyal_completed['revenue_float'].mean()

# Print result
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers: {mean_revenue_loyal}")"}
